head: d59bdf4

rows.note: pricing.position calls value_stack.outcome_price on finished size, make hours and colours, anchored on the observed department median (>=5 BenchmarkListing rows) or the labelled band midpoint; the result is the proposed price. value_stack() aggregator itself still uncalled; each component has a runtime caller.

trust.may_scale_ads consulted by ads.adjust (blocks eligibility per product, rungs read from readiness/ListingAsset/service_level) and by launch.readiness; growth.journey proof_sweep attaches each passed PhysicalTest and sale LedgerEntry once via trust.record_proof (retention lifetime_total).

support.reply records service.record_response on the case as draft_ready (shadow holds replies) and service_level keeps drafts apart from delivered responses, feeding the #17 trust rung; whether fast support reduces refunds/repeat needs orders.

growth.journey reads every promotion Experiment against its organic control via promotion.incrementality daily, marks a non-paying one not_repeatable and opens promotion:catalogue_conditioned; no promotion has run.

pricing.position reads runrate.per_visitor_from_db and refuses a conversion-led cut when a higher-priced sibling earns more per visitor; ads.adjust funds eligible products in contribution-per-visitor order; listing.seo refills freed tag slots from earning-per-visit terms first.

scale.evidence.derive_conditions derives all QUALITATIVE_CONDITIONS (incl. new conservative_scenario_near_target) from rows in weekly.solve (ops.capacity) and /api/scale; unmet-by-default with evidence, so the >=75% band opens only on data.

POST /api/attribution/stats (ops-token) parses the owner's Etsy Stats CSV, joins to orders (contribution rate, support/repeat per term), stores attribution.stats; listing.seo reads it and swaps vanity tags for earning terms. Real gate: the owner must export the CSV.

growth.journey and /api/benchmarks build cells from ListingOutcome/Order/SupportCase rows, diagnose each listing against its own cell and open/reconcile benchmark:<slug>:below_cohort incidents naming factors to test; UNMEASURED until live listings have traffic.

benchmarks.opportunities now called daily from growth.journey with markets from arbitrage.score_observed demand plus our impressions/CTR/conversion per department; ranked list in the reading; needs our traffic to rank on.

ads.adjust daily applies paid_media.organic_first_gate from organic ListingOutcome periods and blocks the product; ads.campaign is dead-lettered without the owner's SpendLimit, capped in code with it, spends nothing.

risk-adjusted allowable CAC from listed price, fees and measured refund rate (refused under 20 orders) gates ads.adjust; new-customer/blended CAC and contribution-after-ads computed from Customer/Order/Ledger in scale.evidence.cac, in the weekly reading and the ads plan.
ads.adjust computes offsite_ads_forecast from Order.offsite_ad_attributed and trailing-365 sales on the policy reading's terms; UNMEASURED with no orders.
ads.adjust asks paid_media.share_and_save daily; with no official fee-benefit rate recorded it reports UNMEASURED by name rather than a guess.

growth.distribution plans a pin set per certified product from calendar milestones (pins.schedule/check_set), destination = published listing, and grows a war-room winner by one new angle via pins.amplify; no Pinterest surface exists to post to.
clusters built daily per department from counted complaint themes (LearningObservation customer_pain + SupportCase themes) ending on a certified product; no owned site to host them.
video.plan per flagship (>=20 maker hours) with troubleshooting seeded from themes; when release_hash moves every module is re-planned as stale. Recording/hosting needs a surface.
creators.portfolio runs daily on Collaboration rows with contribution from creator:<ref>-attributed orders; measured-weak active collaborations are set to stopped; empty roster reads UNMEASURED.

may_graduate runs daily per tester on PhysicalTest reliability and CreatorProfile advocate consent; a cleared tester becomes one zero-cost OwnerAction creators.graduate:<ref> (not duplicated). No tester exists.
tools.check_flow for every FLOW and tools.frequency cap over CASL-consenting customers run daily; sends=0 with the reason. No sending capability.

commerce.readings answers cadence today from median gap between certified releases (club.check_cadence), demand/support from Customer/SupportCase when >=20 customers; club.may_launch reads those answers and a yes becomes an owner card.
tools.check_tool runs daily for every TOOL against the certified product it leads to; hostable list in the reading; hosting needs a surface.

stars read from Order.reviewed detail; listing-routed themes open review_route:<theme> incidents; reviews.check_support_copy runs on every support.reply draft and a gating phrase empties the answer, escalates and audits.
gallery built daily from stored image-provenance rows per product and proof_lift measured across gallery/no-gallery outcome arms; no permissioned customer project exists.
before_the_first_customer verdicts open/reconcile first_hundred:<priority> incidents daily and are launch items in launch.readiness outstanding.
interviews.may_open and invite_gate with CASL consent basis run daily over customers/first orders; sent=0.
friction.listing_audit on every stored listing daily; each defect a friction:<slug>:<confusion> incident, resolved when the listing answers it.

ops.capacity records next week's forecast before the week; evidence.calibration scores ended weeks against orders/outcomes and passes calibration_ceiling into confidence.probability in weekly.solve and /api/scale.

growth.steer hourly reads the weekly reallocation, raises pending jobs for the constraint's owners by a bounded credit once, and ranks RegisteredExperiments on the constraint's levers (war_room board sorts by steer_rank).
seasonal roll-forward moves from the daily reading raise jobs for the occasion gaining capacity and lower the one losing it, in the queue.
evidence.scenarios runs target.matrix on runrate's observed conversion when one exists (basis observed, labelled), assumed only otherwise; used by weekly.solve and /api/scale.

seasonal_evergreen_balance, observed_bundle_aov, low_defect_refund_severity, downside_near_target added to QUALITATIVE_CONDITIONS and derived from rows; meaningful-sample threshold adapts to the observed rate; conditions passed to the gate.
growth.steer reads war_room.board hourly: winners move up the queue and experiment ranking; primary constraint recorded; ads.adjust reads winner_alerts for escalation.
fast-lane admitted slugs from the seasonal reading get -20 priority and an unlisted admitted product gets a chain.rebuild enqueued at the seasonal_deadline band.
ads.adjust computes each seasonal product's pre-season learning window from calendar milestones (opens at indexing, must be running by promotional ramp) and blocks outside it.
non-ad scaling runs: winners get a new pin angle and queue priority; a budget increase beyond the 25% band becomes an OwnerAction ads.scale:<slug> with exact economics. Spend itself is the owner's.

notes: growth.steer moves pending jobs -10 credit once for the constraint's owners and fast-lane admitted slugs -20: cross-band moves to reconcile with the #187 band test at merge
value_stack() aggregator itself has no runtime caller; its three parts do
